prior_art.basis: Independent review by claude-independent-prior-art-reviewer-20261106: No open or discoverable solution provides a quality pre-school run by a teacher with an AI assistant in every village, and the Main KPI of 500,000 villages with a quality pre-school is not verifiably met. The nearest known answer is in India: Rocket Learning works with the Anganwadi daycare network and reports about 400,000 Anganwadi workers, about 6 million children and parents, 15 states and about 30% of India's public pre-schools, with play-based content, educator training, WhatsApp groups and an AI-enabled parent coach; its outcome claims (75% school-ready) carry no published method or comparison group (https://rocketlearning.org/). Anganwadi pre-school quality studies report gaps in infrastructure and pre-school education (https://doi.org/10.1007/s44217-025-00555-x), and an Indian RCT of adaptive WhatsApp nudging targets caregiver engagement, not teacher practice (https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.7038300). Mobile-based teacher support shows effects in rural Côte d'Ivoire primary schools (https://doi.org/10.3102/00028312261430679). GitHub has no open AI assistant for early-childhood teachers. Honest limit: India's model is close to the KPI in reach, so tasks that replicate WhatsApp content delivery to Anganwadi workers are known answers; the open, checkable work is a teacher-facing AI assistant that measurably raises pre-school quality on a validated instrument, and independently verified quality, outside India as well as in it.
